title: Petri: An open-source AI auditing tool
description: Petri is a new open-source automated auditing tool from Anthropic designed to accelerate AI safety research.

title: Project Vend: Can Claude run a small shop?
description: We let Claude run a small shop in the Anthropic office. Here's what happened.

title: Anthropic Economic Index report: Cadences
description: The latest Economic Index report looks at when people come to Claude, what they produce with it, and how they perceive AI's impact on their work.

title: LLMs and biorisk
description: This article explains why we believe that evaluating biorisk and safeguarding against it is a critical element of responsible AI development.

title: Claude does cyber competitions
description: Throughout 2025, we quietly entered Claude in cybersecurity competitions designed for humans. It often placed in the top 25% of competitors.

title: AI agents find smart contract exploits
description: On a benchmark of real exploited contracts, AI agents found vulnerabilities worth a combined $4.6 million, underscoring the need for AI-powered defense.

title: Vibe physics: The AI grad student
description: A Harvard physicist guided Claude Opus 4.5 through a full quantum chromodynamics research project in two weeks.

title: An alignment assessment of the UK AISI cybertesting incident
description: In a UK AISI evaluation, Mythos 5 took unsanctioned actions that impacted real people and organizations. In this post, we investigate these behaviors from Claude Mythos 5 further, to understand what they reveal about the model’s alignment.

title: Updating our coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy timelines
description: We’re shortening our vulnerability disclosure window from 90 days to 30 days for high- and critical-severity issues, and to 45 days for all other issues.

title: Building strong safety evaluations
description: Recommendations for designing, running, and reporting safety evaluations, based on our own experiences.

title: Coding agents in the social sciences
description: Results from a survey of 1,260 social scientists about AI and coding agent use.

title: Introducing the Anthropic Economic Index
description: Announcement of the new Anthropic Economic Index and description of the new data on AI use in occupations

title: Economic Index: Insights from Claude 3.7 Sonnet
description: The second update from the Anthropic Economic Index on how people are using AI.

title: How people use Claude for support and advice
description: Only 2.9% of Claude conversations involve emotional support, advice, or companionship. We share research on affective use and how we're building safeguards.

title: Challenges in evaluating AI systems
description: Insights from the red teaming approaches we've used to test our AI systems.

title: What 81,000 people told us about AI economics
description: Anthropic's recent survey of 81,000 Claude users provides a way to connect people’s economic concerns with what we’ve quantified in Claude traffic.

title: How AI assistance impacts the formation of coding skills
description: A randomized trial with 52 developers found AI assistance lowered comprehension scores, except when used for explanations rather than delegation.

title: Claude Fable 5.2 solves two open problems in the physics of black holes
description: Claude Fable 5.2 has solved two open problems in theoretical physics. Both concern black holes and the search for a theory of quantum gravity.

title: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
description: Claude formally proved security properties in the compiled code of 123 open-source libraries. Along the way, it found bugs that had eluded detection for years.

title: Working with AI
description: We interviewed people at 58 companies that use Claude about how AI is changing their work. They described few layoffs but reduced hiring, and said the most valuable uses of AI often involved reorganizing roles and workplaces around it.

title: Migrating our Messages API to Rust
description: How we used the existing Messages API to verify the new one, with teams of Claude agents tracking down and fixing differences between the Python and Rust versions.
